critical_findings.title: Handlebars.js Multiple Critical JavaScript Injection Vulnerabilities
critical_findings.risk_assessment: Dev dependency chain, but code execution possible if test templates compromised
critical_findings.immediate_action: npm update ts-jest && npm audit fix
critical_findings.alternative_solution: Replace ts-jest with @swc/jest to eliminate handlebars entirely

moderate_findings.title: Vite Path Traversal in Optimized Deps .map Handling
moderate_findings.risk: Development-only; source code leakage possible via .map file traversal
moderate_findings.note: Vite 8.x is major version bump; test thoroughly

moderate_findings.title: esbuild Dev Server CORS Bypass
moderate_findings.risk: Any website can make requests to dev server; leaks sensitive data

moderate_findings.title: PostCSS XSS via Unescaped </style>
moderate_findings.risk: XSS if user-controlled CSS strings are processed

moderate_findings.title: brace-expansion Zero-step Sequence DoS
moderate_findings.risk: Process hang/memory exhaustion if zero-step glob patterns are processed
moderate_findings.fix: npm update brace-expansion (auto-fixed by npm audit fix)

high_multiplier_dependencies.note: Typical for Node.js; ts-jest brings many transitive deps

license_compliance.note: MIT/Apache-2.0 licenses dominate; no viral license risk

immediate: Backend: npm update ts-jest && npm audit fix (handlebars critical CVE)

medium_term: License Compliance: Install license-checker in CI/CD
Dependency Width: Monitor transitive dependency growth
